chapterInfo.content:
1
Onyankopɔn yi Yosua na ɔkyerɛ no deɛ ɔnyɛ
1Na AWURADE akoa Mose wuo akyiri no, AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Nun ba Yosua, Mose somfoɔ no sɛ: 2#Deut 34.5 M’akoa Mose awu; afei sɔre twa Yordan yi, na wo ne ɔman mu yi nyinaa nkɔ asase a mede merema wɔn, Israelfoɔ, no so.
3 # Deut 11.24 Baabiara a mo nan bɛtia no, mo na mede mama mo, sɛdeɛ meka mekyerɛɛ Mose no, 4ɛfiri serɛ no so ne Lebanon yi ho de kɔsi asu kɛseɛ no, Asubɔntene Eufrate ano, Hetifoɔ asase nyinaa de kɔsi ɛpo kɛseɛ no ano wɔ deɛ owia kɔtɔ hɔ na ɛnyɛ mo hyeɛ.
5 # Deut 31.8; Heb 13.5 Obiara biara rentumi nnyina w’anim, wo nkwa nna nyinaa; sɛdeɛ medii Mose akyire no, saa ara na mɛdi w’akyire; merempa wo na merennya wo. 6#Deut 3.28; 31.7, 23 Wo ho nyɛ den na yɛ nnam, na wo na wobɛkyɛ asase a mekaa wɔn agyanom ntam sɛ mede bɛma wɔn no mu ama ɔman yi. 7#Deut 5.32; 1 Ah 2.3 Wo ho ara na ɛnyɛ den na yɛ nnam pa, na hwɛ di mmara a mehyɛɛ m’akoa Mose no nyinaa so; mfiri ho nkɔ nifa anaa benkum, na deɛ wobɛkorɔ nyinaa woadi yie. 8#Dwom 1.2-3 Mma mmara nwoma yi mmfiri w’anomu, na dwene ho awia ne anadwo, na woahwɛ ayɛ sɛ deɛ wɔatwerɛ no wɔ mu nyinaa teɛ no: Na ɛno na wo kwan bɛyɛ dwoodwoo, na ɛno na ɛbɛsi wo yie. 9Menhyɛɛ wo sɛ yɛ den na yɛ nnam, nsuro, na mma w’akoma nntu anaa? Ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn di w’akyi deɛ wokorɔ nyinaa.
10Ɛnna Yosua hyɛɛ ɔman no ahwɛfoɔ no sɛ: 11Momfa nsraban no mu, na monhyɛ ɔman no sɛ: Monsiesie akwansoduane nsie, na ɛha yi nnansa morebɛtwa Yordan yi akɔfa asase a AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn de rema mo sɛ monni soɔ no.
12Na Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo fa no deɛ, Yosua ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: 13#Num 32.20 Monkae asɛm a AWURADE akoa Mose hyɛɛ mo sɛ: AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn de mo atena ase, na ɔde asase yi ama mo; 14mo yerenom, mo mma ne mo mmoakuo ntena asase a Mose de maa mo Yordan agya yi so, na mo deɛ, monni mo nuanom anim amia mu, akofoɔ nyinaa, na monni mmoa wɔn, 15nkɔsi sɛ AWURADE de mo nuanom bɛtena ase sɛ mo, na wɔn nso wɔbɛdi asase a AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn de rema wɔn no so ansa na moasane aba mo sodie asase no so abɛdi so, sɛ AWURADE akoa Mose de maa mo, Yordan agya owiapueeɛ hɔ no. 16Na wɔbuaa Yosua sɛ: Deɛ woahyɛ yɛn nyinaa, yɛbɛyɛ, na baabiara a wosoma yɛn no, yɛbɛkɔ. 17Sɛdeɛ yɛtiee Mose, ade nyinaa mu no, saa ara na yɛbɛtie woɔ; die na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nni w’akyire, sɛdeɛ ɔdii Mose akyire no. 18#Yos 1.6 Obiara a ɔbɛte w’anomu asɛm ho atua na ɔrentie wo nsɛm, deɛ wobɛhyɛ yɛn nyinaa mu no, wɔnku no. Den ara nko na wo ho nyɛ, na yɛ nnam.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na AWURADE akoa Mose wuo akyiri no, AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Nun ba Yosua, Mose somfoɔ no sɛ: M’akoa Mose awu; afei sɔre twa Yordan yi, na wo ne ɔman mu yi nyinaa nkɔ asase a mede merema wɔn, Israelfoɔ, no so.
Baabiara a mo nan bɛtia no, mo na mede mama mo, sɛdeɛ meka mekyerɛɛ Mose no, ɛfiri serɛ no so ne Lebanon yi ho de kɔsi asu kɛseɛ no, Asubɔntene Eufrate ano, Hetifoɔ asase nyinaa de kɔsi ɛpo kɛseɛ no ano wɔ deɛ owia kɔtɔ hɔ na ɛnyɛ mo hyeɛ.
Obiara biara rentumi nnyina w’anim, wo nkwa nna nyinaa; sɛdeɛ medii Mose akyire no, saa ara na mɛdi w’akyire; merempa wo na merennya wo. Wo ho nyɛ den na yɛ nnam, na wo na wobɛkyɛ asase a mekaa wɔn agyanom ntam sɛ mede bɛma wɔn no mu ama ɔman yi. Wo ho ara na ɛnyɛ den na yɛ nnam pa, na hwɛ di mmara a mehyɛɛ m’akoa Mose no nyinaa so; mfiri ho nkɔ nifa anaa benkum, na deɛ wobɛkorɔ nyinaa woadi yie. Mma mmara nwoma yi mmfiri w’anomu, na dwene ho awia ne anadwo, na woahwɛ ayɛ sɛ deɛ wɔatwerɛ no wɔ mu nyinaa teɛ no: Na ɛno na wo kwan bɛyɛ dwoodwoo, na ɛno na ɛbɛsi wo yie. Menhyɛɛ wo sɛ yɛ den na yɛ nnam, nsuro, na mma w’akoma nntu anaa? Ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn di w’akyi deɛ wokorɔ nyinaa.
Ɛnna Yosua hyɛɛ ɔman no ahwɛfoɔ no sɛ: Momfa nsraban no mu, na monhyɛ ɔman no sɛ: Monsiesie akwansoduane nsie, na ɛha yi nnansa morebɛtwa Yordan yi akɔfa asase a AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn de rema mo sɛ monni soɔ no.
Na Rubenfoɔ ne Gadfoɔ ne Manase abusuakuo fa no deɛ, Yosua ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Monkae asɛm a AWURADE akoa Mose hyɛɛ mo sɛ: AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn de mo atena ase, na ɔde asase yi ama mo; mo yerenom, mo mma ne mo mmoakuo ntena asase a Mose de maa mo Yordan agya yi so, na mo deɛ, monni mo nuanom anim amia mu, akofoɔ nyinaa, na monni mmoa wɔn, nkɔsi sɛ AWURADE de mo nuanom bɛtena ase sɛ mo, na wɔn nso wɔbɛdi asase a AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn de rema wɔn no so ansa na moasane aba mo sodie asase no so abɛdi so, sɛ AWURADE akoa Mose de maa mo, Yordan agya owiapueeɛ hɔ no. Na wɔbuaa Yosua sɛ: Deɛ woahyɛ yɛn nyinaa, yɛbɛyɛ, na baabiara a wosoma yɛn no, yɛbɛkɔ. Sɛdeɛ yɛtiee Mose, ade nyinaa mu no, saa ara na yɛbɛtie woɔ; die na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nni w’akyire, sɛdeɛ ɔdii Mose akyire no. Obiara a ɔbɛte w’anomu asɛm ho atua na ɔrentie wo nsɛm, deɛ wobɛhyɛ yɛn nyinaa mu no, wɔnku no. Den ara nko na wo ho nyɛ, na yɛ nnam.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
